title: Djokovic Loses and Misses the ATP Finals
summary: Novak Djokovic's tennis season is over. The 39-year-old star lost to Rinky Hijikata of Australia in the second round of the Paris Masters on Wednesday. The score was 2-6, 6-3, 6-3. Hijikata is ranked 83rd in the world and had to qualify to play. The loss means Djokovic will miss the ATP Finals in Turin. He likely needed to reach the semi-finals in Paris to qualify. Djokovic started well, but Hijikata played better late in the match. Djokovic looked tired and made many errors. After the match, Djokovic said his plan is "just rest." "I'm looking forward to it," he added. He also praised Hijikata: "He played really amazing tennis." Djokovic has won a men's record 24 Grand Slam titles. This is only the second time in 20 years that he has failed to qualify for the season-ending event when fit. He reached the Australian Open final and the Wimbledon semi-finals this year. Now only Taylor Fritz and Tommy Paul still have a chance to take the last two spots in Turin.
why_it_matters: Even the best player in the world can lose, which is why watching sports is so exciting.
